summary: Present 68-foot steel lookout on Clay Hill, Barnstable, built 1947 after the wooden and steel towers on Shoot Flying Hill (1897, 1914) came down; 2014 visit found it unstaffed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The two registers describe two sites. NHLR covers the standing tower on Clay Hill, and FFLOS covers the former tower on Shoot Flying Hill that was removed in 1947. The record's coordinates follow NHLR, which fits the standing tower.

notes_for_editor: Good sources for the layout of the site (NHLR, FFLOS, Forest Lookouts, Brush Breakers), but the dates disagree and no source gives current access. Conflicts to check: (1) present tower built 1947 (NHLR; the Shoot Flying Hill tower removed 1947 per FFLOS) vs relocated to Clay Hill in 1948 (Brush Breakers). The record keeps 1947. (2) Steel tower 1912 (NHLR) vs 1914 (FFLOS, Brush Breakers); height 48 ft (FFLOS) vs 50 ft (passage quoted on the Forest Lookouts page). (3) First wooden tower 1897 (NHLR, FFLOS, Brush Breakers) vs 1890 (Forest Lookouts summary). (4) Site elevation: NHLR 66 ft (20 m, matches record elevation_m 20.1) vs Brush Breakers hill elevation around 200 ft; the story does not use either elevation. Correction proposed: the FFLOS US 35 registration belongs to the former site, not to the standing tower. Access and ownership today: not found in any page read; the story says so. Status standing is from the 2014 visit and an undated Brush Breakers page; not verified after 2014. Not fetched and not cited: Forest Fire Lookout Association Massachusetts Facebook snippets describing the 1947 tower as built late summer 1947 and as still standing on Clay Hill. Worth checking before adding any access level. No photos added (the FFLOS page lists photos but none were read). Unknown: notable fires at either site; none found in the pages read. Checked 2026-10-08: the 48-ft and 1947-removal claims come from the firetower.org former-site page (cite 2), not the Forest Lookouts page; the 1904 date for the Benson article is the page's own claim and conflicts with its 'last year' wording, so the story attributes it to the page. The 1911 selection item is the Sandwich Observer (October 31, 1911) as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the 1922 item is the Barnstable Patriot (May 15, 1922).
